name: Fuchū (Hiroshima, Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Fuchū city emblem in navy: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised pointed device.
history: Municipal flag of Fuchū, a city in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 June 1954.

features.role: Fuchū city emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised pointed device
